description: Send one message to a queue or an agent later: in 30m, or at a time
author: Serg Parf

in.help: Send the message once after a delay, as #at; the target must allow #at

args.name: in
args.help: 90s, 30m, 2h or 3d: one unit, at most 366 days

args.name: target
args.help: Queue or agent whose access list allows #at

args.name: body
args.help: The rest of the line, sent unchanged; not empty, at most 16384 bytes

in.returns: Id, the due instant with its offset, and the agent's time zone
in.example: agent-bus call '#at@node.example' 'in 30m #claude/main@node.example is the deploy still green?'

at.help: Send the message once at a time: HH:MM next in Configuration tz, or RFC 3339 with an offset

args.name: at
args.help: HH:MM (next occurrence, strictly after this minute) or an RFC 3339 instant with an offset

args.name: target
args.help: Queue or agent whose access list allows #at

args.name: body
args.help: The rest of the line, sent unchanged; not empty, at most 16384 bytes

at.returns: Id, the due instant with its offset, and the agent's time zone

list.help: Show your pending calls and recent outcomes, and the agent's time zone; staff see all

cancel.help: Cancel a pending call; its creator or the agent's Owner and Maintainers

tz.help: IANA time zone for HH:MM times; must exist in the host's time zone data
